answer: An AI-agent market grants each identity one job slot backed by a locked $100 deposit; its ledger prevents the same funds from backing multiple slots. Closing an account disables its slot and starts a 30-day withdrawal delay. Naming fresh accounts river, dune and inlet creates no free capacity: each requires separate funds. Every additional fake identity ties up $100, costing about $0.82 per 30 days at a 10% annual funding rate, even without detection.
